answer: I would anchor trust in Attested leatherworker guild membership with leather guild attestation. With a membership the guild kept across years of hides, a single willow check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the zephyr is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The glacier grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
